controls_status.name: Broken access control / IDOR
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:72-74 authn required (uid None -> 401); app-clean/app.py:78-80 query scoped WHERE id=? AND owner_id=?; 404 on miss (no leak)

controls_status.name: Authentication
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:59 bcrypt.checkpw used; no plaintext/MD5 path; generic 401 on failure

controls_status.name: Privilege / role gating
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:34-42 identity derived server-side from token (not client-supplied flag)

controls_status.name: SQL injection
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:50-53 login parameterized (?, (username,)); app-clean/app.py:78-81 item parameterized + int route converter (line 69)

controls_status.name: XSS
controls_status.evidence: JSON-only responses; no secrets reflected; no raw HTML sink

controls_status.name: Input validation
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:45 server-side username regex + password length check before use; app-clean/app.py:69 int route converter

controls_status.name: Deserialization/SSRF
controls_status.evidence: no untrusted deserialization or outbound URL

controls_status.name: Hardcoded secrets
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:15-17 DB_PASSWORD/API_KEY/secret_key read from os.environ; none in source
controls_status.fix: n/a (ensure .env gitignored + secret store in prod)

controls_status.name: Sensitive data exposure
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:62 login returns only a token (issue_token); no secret in body; generic error messages

controls_status.name: Rate limiting
controls_status.evidence: no throttling on /login -> credential-stuffing risk remains

controls_status.name: Error handling
controls_status.evidence: app-clean/app.py:89 debug=False; generic error JSON, no stack traces

controls_status.name: CSRF
controls_status.evidence: token in Authorization header (not cookie) reduces CSRF, but not explicitly enforced
controls_status.fix: Enforce SameSite/CSRF token if cookie-based sessions are added

negative_cases: SQLi: username = "' OR '1'='1" -> bound as literal param, no match -> 401 (B1 pass)
IDOR: authenticated user requests item owned by another -> owner_id filter -> 404 (A1 pass)
Invalid input: username with ';' or 200-char password -> 400 before query (B4 pass)
Auth: wrong password -> bcrypt.checkpw False -> 401 (A2 pass)
residual_risk: No rate limiting on /login (D2) — brute force/credential stuffing possible
Security headers not set (D1); CSRF not explicitly enforced (D5)
Token issuance/verification are placeholders — signing/expiry must be verified in real impl
Threats outside this static review remain: dependency CVEs, infra/TLS config, runtime/business-logic abuse
note: checks passed != secure; P0 controls verified with evidence, but residual risk remains and this is not a claim of being secure/unhackable
